intro: Government, critical infrastructure, financial services, healthcare, and law enforcement face the threats covered across seven FBI articles published between April 13 and September 23, 2026. Handala Hack, Interlock, and LummaC2 appear as the top threat actors in this coverage, which also tracks CVE-2026-35273. The affected regions span the United States, Global, Iran, and North America. Six of the seven articles carry a high severity rating, reflecting the weight of the incidents documented here. This archive gathers reporting on the actors, vulnerabilities, and sectors central to the FBI's recent casework.
